name: reserve_forecast_current_2026YTD

columns.revenue_eur: total revenue = afrr_capacity_eur + afrr_energy_eur + imbalance_revenue_eur - penalty_eur
columns.energy_mwh: BRP perimeter (imbalance) energy = metered - requested aFRR energy
columns.price_eur_mwh: single imbalance price of the mechanism
columns.afrr_capacity_eur: reserved MW x capacity price paid x 0.25 h
columns.afrr_energy_eur: requested aFRR energy x aFRR energy price (up earns, down pays)
columns.shortfall_imbalance_eur: undelivered aFRR energy settled at the imbalance price
columns.penalty_eur: activation-control penalty on undelivered energy (0 unless configured)
columns.shortfall_mwh: requested aFRR energy that could not be delivered (SOC or power limits)

approximations: aFRR activation of the battery is approximated pro rata from Belgian activated / awarded aFRR volume
capacity remuneration uses the published awards as clearing proxy (see capacity_clearing)
before 2024-11-26 (PICASSO) aFRR energy was pay-as-bid; see activation_model
